classification.difficultyReason: Interpret intersection with the integers as selecting isolated integer points from the closed interval.

content.prompt:
Sketch the following on a number line.
$[0,3]\cap\mathbb Z$

answer.worked:
Retain only integers in the closed interval:
$$[0,3]\cap\mathbb Z=\{0,1,2,3\}.$$
Plot four isolated filled points.

spec.description: Four isolated filled points at 0, 1, 2 and 3.
